name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Channel Development Lead role. Building the systems and reporting that make a sales channel run better is the throughline of my last 15 years: CRM architecture, KPI dashboards, and go-to-market strategy across SaaS and agency environments, translated into roadmaps that other teams execute against.

At Accelo I sold and scoped CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, then built sequenced implementation plans ranking which systems to change and in what order, working directly with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational design. At Birdeye I managed a network of 15 to 20 reseller partners, retaining all but one, by tracking utilization and performance data to catch adoption gaps before they became churn. At Solenzo I architect CRM systems and build the performance dashboards that turn pipeline and funnel data into decisions for business owners.

I'll be direct about the gap: my sales and CRM experience is in SaaS and agency environments, not health solutions specifically. What I bring instead is the operating core this role is built on: connecting channel strategy to CRM systems to KPI reporting, and communicating that clearly to strategic-level stakeholders. I'd welcome the conversation.
